messages.subject: Interested in mentoring
parts:
Hi list members

I recently came across the GSoC 2011 webpage

http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2011

for the R project and signed up for this list. After announcing GSoC
to the students at my university, I have at least one student, who is
interested in applying for a project. I would be able to work as a
mentor, and I have some projects, he could work on. We are right
now working out what he can do and is interested in. The question is,
how do we proceed. On the page mentioned above, can I just add a
project? (clicking on suggestion_form sends me to the cranvastime project?)

Best, Niels
